module arbiter_09 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [3:0] req,
  output [3:0] gnt
);

  reg [3:0] grant_reg;
  reg [1:0] node_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      grant_reg <= 4'b0000;
      node_reg <= 2'd0;
    end else begin
      if (req != 4'b0000) begin
        // Find the next node with request
        if (req[node_reg]) begin
          grant_reg <= 4'b0001 << node_reg;
        end else begin
          // Rotate to next node
          node_reg <= (node_reg + 1) % 4;
          // Check if we've rotated full circle
          if (node_reg == 3) begin
            grant_reg <= 4'b0000;
          end else begin
            grant_reg <= 4'b0000;
          end
        end
      end else begin
        // No requests, reset to node 0
        grant_reg <= 4'b0000;
        node_reg <= 2'd0;
      end
    end
  end

  assign gnt = grant_reg;

endmodule

  input [3:0] req,

  reg [1:0] node_reg;
